description: CCP beacon signature gate vectors: verify L2 signature verification occurs BEFORE DIO processing (spec section 8). Tests that invalid signatures cause frame rejection with no DODAG state change. Also captures known divergence points in path_cost calculation (rounding, MAX_RANK_INCREASE defaults) for cross-implementation alignment.

vectors.name: sig_gate_invalid_rejects_before_dio
vectors.description: Frame with invalid L2 signature MUST be rejected at link layer before DIO processing. No DODAG state change occurs. This is the primary safety invariant.

vectors.name: sig_gate_valid_allows_dio
vectors.description: Frame with valid L2 signature passes link layer, DIO processing occurs.

vectors.name: path_cost_exact_integer
vectors.description: ETX=1.0 produces exact integer path_cost (no rounding divergence). rank + round(1.0 * 256) = 256 + 256 = 512.

vectors.name: path_cost_round_down
vectors.description: ETX=1.25 rounds down in both implementations. 256 + round(1.25 * 256) = 256 + round(320.0) = 256 + 320 = 576.

vectors.name: path_cost_round_up
vectors.description: ETX=1.75 rounds up in both implementations. 256 + round(1.75 * 256) = 256 + round(448.0) = 256 + 448 = 704.

vectors.name: path_cost_half_boundary_python_even
vectors.description: ETX that produces .5 in link_cost. Python banker's rounding rounds 0.5 to nearest even (128 -> 128). Rust rounds away from zero (128.5 -> 129). This is a KNOWN DIVERGENCE point.

vectors.name: path_cost_half_boundary_python_odd
vectors.description: ETX that produces 129.5 in link_cost. Python banker's rounding rounds 129.5 to nearest even (130). Rust rounds away from zero (129.5 -> 130). Both agree here.

vectors.name: path_cost_overflow_saturation
vectors.description: Very high ETX causing overflow. Both implementations should return INFINITE_RANK (65535).

vectors.name: path_cost_nan_handling
vectors.description: NaN link_etx. Rust explicitly returns u16::MAX. Python raises ValueError when round() receives NaN.
vectors.note: Rust dodag.rs:172 explicitly checks is_nan() and returns u16::MAX. Python round(nan) raises ValueError.

vectors.name: path_cost_negative_etx_rejected
vectors.description: Negative ETX is invalid. Python raises ValueError at ParentCandidate creation. Rust returns u16::MAX from path_cost.
vectors.note: Python ParentCandidate.__post_init__ raises ValueError for negative ETX

vectors.name: admissibility_within_python_ceiling
vectors.description: Path cost within Python MAX_RANK_INCREASE=2048 but outside Rust MAX_RANK_INCREASE=1024. Both implementations accept if MAX_RANK_INCREASE configured to 2048.
vectors.note: ceiling = lowest_rank + MAX_RANK_INCREASE. Python: 512+2048=2560. Rust default: 512+1024=1536. 1792 < 2560 but 1792 > 1536.

vectors.name: admissibility_below_both_ceilings
vectors.description: Path cost below both Python and Rust MAX_RANK_INCREASE ceilings. Both accept.

vectors.name: admissibility_above_both_ceilings
vectors.description: Path cost above both MAX_RANK_INCREASE ceilings. Both reject.

vectors.name: dio_from_unknown_sender
vectors.description: DIO from sender not in peer table. Signature cannot be verified. Frame rejected at L2.

vectors.name: dio_replay_rejected
vectors.description: DIO with sequence number already seen. Signature verifies but replay protection rejects at L2.
